description: Source code for the LPS22DF pressure and temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: lps22df_mode_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the output data rate (ODR) for the LPS22DF sensor.

methods.name: lps22df_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches pressure and temperature sample data from the sensor.

methods.name: lps22df_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready interrupt, reads status, and calls registered handler.

methods.name: lps22df_enable_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the sensor's interrupt pin.

methods.name: lps22df_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures external trigger for data ready events.

methods.name: st_lps22df_init
methods.description: Initializes the LPS22DF sensor device, including ID check, reset, configuration, and optional interrupt setup.
